theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks lead the eligible cohort with the strongest trend-gate signal (eligible=true, durability 0.67, breadth 0.692) and modest crowding (z=0.93, not flagged crowded). Because the validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate for staying-power/drawdown control, being on the side of the most durable trend-health name is the only defensible conditional lean. Momentum rank itself is a focus lens, not a buy signal, so this is honored only because trend eligibility and durability are also present.
theses.dissent: Banks have hurst_tag='mixed' (not 'trend'), so trend persistence is not clean; a mean-reversion whipsaw could undo the trend-gate's drawdown benefit at exactly the wrong time.
